'''Sanya Tagge''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] member of the [[House of Tagge/Legends|House of Tagge]], and served as [[Baron/Legends|baroness]] from during the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]] and the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="hnn" /> She was the mother of [[Silas Tagge/Legends|Silas]], [[Cassio Tagge/Legends|Cassio]], [[Ulric Tagge/Legends|Ulric]], [[Domina Tagge/Legends|Domina]] and [[Orman Tagge/Legends|Orman]]. It was Orman who succeeded her as House ruler.

In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], Sanya was quick to announce her family's devotion to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], becoming one of the few major business conglomerates not to join the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="hnn" />

==Biography==
When more and more systems were leaving the [[Galactic Republic]] shortly before the outbreak of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], Sanya reassured the people of her homeworld [[Tepasi/Legends|Tepasi]] that her family would continue to be loyal to the Republic. She pointed out that House Tagge was aware of the heritage of its ancestral ancestor, one of the original founders of the Republic, and continued to support her family's attachment to the Republic, her belief in the [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]], and her willingness to continue serving her faith in the Republic.<ref name="hnn" />

The Baroness, while expressing her loyalty to the Republic unequivocally, withheld promises of concrete assistance to the government. At that time, House Tagge had a fleet of over five thousand armed ships and a private army of over one million soldiers. Nonetheless, Sanya's manifestation of loyalty to a corporation like that of her family was unusual, as most large corporations remained neutral during the crisis.<ref name="hnn" />
